title: Review annotations to peptidyl-x biosynthetic process from y

author: pgaudet
body:
- There are 5 annotations to these terms, 1 MGI and 4 UniProt (will be automatically replaced as described in the ticket: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32100
- There is 1 InterPro mapping: InterPro:IPR007788 Glutaminyl-peptide cyclotransferase > GO:peptidyl-pyroglutamic acid biosynthetic process, using glutaminyl-peptide cyclotransferase ; GO:0017186 >> replace by GO:0018199 peptidyl-glutamine modification

Thanks, Pascale
